properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for validating privileged access strategy
properties.description:
The privileged access strategy must provide consistent access control in order to enforce segregation of hierarchy between the different planes and prevent unauthorized privilege escalation between planes e.g :
  • Cloud control plane
  • Management plane of workloads
  • Data plane
